admin.delegation.description: Lets the assistant hand a sub-task to a sub-agent that works on its own and returns only its answer, up to three at a time. The {#code}{preset}{/code} preset is a sub-agent that searches the web and reads sources. Each sub-agent makes its own model calls, billed to the person like any message, and can use the chat's server-side tools, including connector tools the conversation already allows. It never raises an approval card: a tool that needs approval is refused.
